description: This file defines the WebProcessor class used for processing log records, adding session and request info, and handling object context processing within the Goteo application.

classes.name: WebProcessor
classes.description: A class for processing log records, enriching them with session, request, and contextual object data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes WebProcessor with a Request object.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Processes a log record by calling processRecord.

methods.name: processRecord
methods.description: Enriches a log record with session, user, IP, method, language, currency, and shadowed_by info.

methods.name: processObject
methods.description: Converts objects into associative arrays with standardized properties for logging.
